comment: Monthly transaction-banking fee income per client from Apr-2024 to Sep-2026, by fee type, product and booking country (shared by the Cash & Payments and the Trade & SCF spaces). Fee lines booked by the finance engine (account maintenance, portal / host-to-host / API channel fees, liquidity-structure fees; local billing currency) plus the fees derived in gold from the transactions with the bank's tariff - payment processing (USD 3 per payment message), cross-border payment commission (10 bps of cross-border value), trade-finance commissions per instrument, and FX margin income (Markets, flagged is_tb_fee = false). Derived lines reconcile with the finance engine's client revenue. SCF discount income is not a fee (see fact_scf_programme_drawdown). All amounts are monthly flows (additive). Grain: one row per golden client per month per fee type per product per booking country per fee currency.
